name: markup between two backticks a blank line apart
why: A code span ends at the paragraph break, so a renderer pairs neither of these backticks and emits a real element for the tag between them. A reader that treats everything between two backticks as quoted code calls the same text safe, and markup nobody reviewed reaches the page. A fact is one line for that reason: where a paragraph ends depends on the blocks around the text, which a string does not carry.
